description: Under OpenTarget, once the designated first participant completes, the responder may see only the primary comparison metric of that result before starting their own attempt - no other metric.
notes: Implemented by issue #11: VersusSeries.StartAttempt gates the non-first-mover behind the first mover's completion (EnsureIssuanceOrderAllows) and VersusSeries.ToView reveals only Rules.ComparisonKeys[0] of the first mover's result to the responder before the round resolves (PartialRevealMetricFor), mirroring Unity's SeriesSnapshot.FirstAttemptParticipantIndex + VersusGame.CanIssueTo + VersusGame.ViewFor. Selecting OpenTarget through the live remote CreateChallenge/StaticRulesetCatalog path still requires a catalog entry with InformationPolicy=OpenTarget, which issue #10's catalog population does not yet provide - this fixture proves the domain semantic directly, independent of catalog content.
